surface_value: There are serious shortcomings in the evidence that has been adduced. By way of illustration, there is no evidence that the works being performed on the hospital were 'unauthorised' by the New South Wales Department of Health or the local Council. There is no evidence that the hospital did not comply with fire safety requirements or that they could not be lawfully and safely occupied.
